messages:
ops-bot: [INCIDENT] embeddings-service (eu-west-1) elevated error rate detected for enterprise customers. error spike started ~08:12 UTC. paging: @mia_sre (oncall). logs: https://redwood-infra/logs/trace/3350012345
mia_sre: I'm on it. hitting 502/504 on realtime endpoints and timeouts on batch jobs. grabbing shard health now.
raj_oncall: I see a correlated autoscaler churn event around 08:10 UTC. wondering if a rollout caused unstable instances.
emily_eng: no deploys in prod at that window from infra team. but kernel OOMs reported on a few nodes.
selena_cs: Valencia Corp just opened a ticket (VAL-1987). their scheduled nightly embedding jobs are failing. they want a tailored comm.
daniel_account: Tagging for account escalation: Valencia (primary contacts: kate@valencia.co, +1-415-555-0133), AM: daniel_account. Also notify AegisHealth and NorthRiver if blast radius includes their projects.
mia_sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert Valencia traffic to fallback embedding pool (v1.2-quant) 2) disable batch autoscaler for eu-west-1 3) spin up 3 warm nodes. executing step 1 now.
ops-bot: ACTION: route rule applied — traffic for customer tag valencia-corp -> fallback-pool-v1.2 (confirmed).
selena_cs: Draft customer message for Valencia — please review: "Hi Kate — we're currently investigating elevated failures for embeddings jobs in eu-west-1. We've routed your jobs to a fallback pool which should restore most jobs; some in-flight jobs may need retrying. ETA for stable service: 60-90 minutes. We'll send an updated status at 09:00 UTC or sooner."
emily_eng: Suggested technical addition for the message: include recommended retry pattern and TTL: retry with exponential backoff x3, wait 30s between attempts. Also note any generated vectors may be on v1.2 quantized profile.
daniel_account: Approved — send ASAP and offer a 1:1 bridge if they want live updates.
mia_sre: Update: fallback pool restored ~70% of realtime requests; batch queue still showing 15% failures. continuing node provisioning, will follow up with exact counts.
statusbot: [STATUS PAGE DRAFT] "Embeddings — degraded: We are investigating elevated error rates in eu-west-1 causing intermittent failures for embeddings jobs for a small set of enterprise customers. Mitigation in progress (traffic routed to fallback pool). Next update 09:00 UTC."
selena_cs: I'll post the tailored Valencia note and post the status page draft once we confirm batch recovery metrics. posting now. :white_check_mark:
raj_oncall: FYI for handoff — @mia_sre will remain primary, @raj_oncall standby for escalations. If not resolved by 10:00 UTC escalate to infra lead @emily_eng.
mia_sre: Copy. creating an internal runbook entry and tagging this thread. will post final closure when all queues are green.
ops-bot: INCIDENT ACTION LOGGED: 3350012345 - Valencia embeddings impact - mitigation: fallback routing, node reprovision.
